method: Read the complete assigned canonical and English documents and compare meanings, statuses, examples, tables, defaults, authority/approval/lease boundaries and limitations.

Four UX pairs reviewed by the report writer; six memory/operations pairs reviewed by an independent delegated reader, with its minor finding rechecked against both original lines by the report writer.
Read-only SHA256/source-marker checks and fenced-block/NOT RUN-count checks supplement, but do not replace, the semantic comparison.

limits: Only these ten page pairs were reviewed; this is not a claim that all 226 mirrors were reviewed.
Source-relative links are intentionally pending a later rewrite; resolved-link correctness is outside this review.
Fenced examples, including original-language content, are intentionally verbatim. Fenced-block equality is checked after LF/CRLF normalization.
Canonical facts and historical status were assessed for translation fidelity, not independently changed or revalidated.
PASS here concerns the reviewed translation snapshots; it is not browser, build, API, model, acoustic, physics, audio, performance or full V1 acceptance evidence.
